products.name: Fried Crab
products.description: Crab is a dish where crabs are typically coated in a seasoned batter and deep-fried until crispy. The seasoning often includes a mix of garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sometimes gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes) for a hint of spice.

products.name: Fried Chicken Wings
products.description: 5 pcs - Tender chicken wings, expertly seasoned & fried to perfect golden crispiness.

products.name: Squid Tempura
products.description: Squid tempura is a Japanese dish where squid is coated in a light tempura batter and deep-fried until crispy. To make it, clean and slice fresh squid, dip it in a cold tempura batter, and fry until golden brown. Serve with a dipping sauce made from soy sauce, mirin, and grated daikon radish

products.name: Kimchi Jeon
products.description: Kimchi pancake

products.name: Fish Pan Cake
products.description: Fish Pan Cake : Korean pancake with sliced white fish, flour-cornstarch batter, fry until golden. Optional veggies. Enjoy as an appetizer or side dish!

products.name: Korean Fried Chicken
products.description: 7 pcs - Bangkok Fried Chicken: Marinate chicken in a mix of garlic, coriander, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and white pepper. Coat with cornstarch or rice flour and fry until golden brown. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce. Enjoy the crispy and flavorful Thai-style fried chicken!

products.name: Mixed Tempura
products.description: Mixed tempura is a Japanese dish consisting of squid rings, prawns, onions, capsicum, and various vegetables, all coated in a delicate, crispy batter and deep-fried until golden.

products.name: Fish Cutlet
products.description: A fish cutlet is a dish made by shaping seasoned fish mixture into patties, coating them with breadcrumbs, and frying or baking until golden brown.

products.name: Fish Finger
products.description: Fish fingers are a popular convenience food made from boneless and skinless white fish fillets, coated in breadcrumbs, and typically served after being deep-fried or oven-baked.

products.name: Beef Kim Bap
products.description: 6pcs - Beef kimbap is a Korean dish that consists of seasoned rice, vegetables, and thinly sliced beef rolled in seaweed sheets. The filling typically includes ingredients like carrots, spinach, pickled radish, and strips of cooked beef. The roll is then sliced into bite-sized pieces, creating a flavorful and satisfying hand-held meal.

products.name: Tuna Kim Bap
products.description: 6pcs - Tuna kimbap is a Korean dish that involves seasoned rice and various ingredients rolled in seaweed sheets. In the case of tuna kimbap, the filling includes tuna, along with vegetables like carrots, spinach, and pickled radish. The roll is then sliced into bite-sized pieces, creating a convenient and delicious hand-held snack or meal.

products.name: Chicken Teriyaki
products.description: 1:1 - Taste the harmony of sweet & savory chicken teriyaki glazed in signature teriyaki sauce

products.name: Chicken Bulgogi
products.description: 1:1 - Prepared with soy sauce, brown sugar, boneless chicken breasts, chili & seasonings

products.name: Dak Kkanjgeong
products.description: Dak Kangjeong is a Korean dish featuring bite-sized, deep-fried chicken glazed in a sweet and spicy sauce, commonly made with soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and gochujang.

products.name: Red Chili Crab
products.description: Red chili crab is a popular Singaporean and Malaysian dish where crab is cooked in a spicy and flavorful sauce made with red chili paste, garlic, ginger, and various seasonings. The dish is known for its vibrant red color and bold, spicy taste. It is often enjoyed with steamed or fried buns to soak up the delicious sauce.

products.name: Beef Bulgogi
products.description: Beef bulgogi is a Korean dish consisting of thinly sliced beef marinated in a sweet and savory sauce made with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and pepper. The marinated beef is typically grilled or stir-fried, resulting in a flavorful and tender dish. It is often served with rice and vegetables.

products.name: Beef Teriyaki
products.description: 1:1 - Beef teriyaki is a Japanese dish featuring thinly sliced beef that is grilled or pan-fried and glazed with a glossy teriyaki sauce. The sauce typically consists of soy sauce, sake or mirin, sugar, and mirin, creating a sweet and savory flavor.

products.name: Chicken Kkapunggi
products.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi is a Korean-Chinese dish known for its spicy and savory flavor. It typically features deep-fried chicken pieces coated in a sauce made with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and chili flakes. Vegetables such as onions and bell peppers are often included, adding to the dish's texture and taste.

products.name: Chicken Tangsu
products.description: Chicken Tangsu - often known as sweet and sour chicken, is a Korean-Chinese dish. It involves crispy, deep-fried pieces of chicken coated in a tangy and sweet sauce made with ingredients such as vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and fruit juices.

products.name: Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl
products.description: Spicy marinated chicken served over rice with vegetable & a savory sauce

products.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl
products.description: Savory marinated beef served over rice, topped with vegetable & a flavorful sauce

products.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
products.description: Savory marinated seafood served over rice, topped with vegetable & a flavorful sauce

products.name: Chicken Fried Rice
products.description: Chicken fried rice is a popular Asian dish made by stir-frying pre-cooked rice with diced chicken, vegetables, and seasonings. The dish typically includes ingredients like soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sometimes peas, carrots, and onions.

products.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
products.description: 1:1 - Vegetable fried rice is a Chinese dish made by stir-frying cooked rice with vegetables like carrots, peas, and bell peppers. It includes scrambled or stir-fried eggs for added flavor and protein.

products.name: Garlic Fried Rice
products.description: 1:1 - Garlic fried rice is a dish where cooked rice is stir-fried with minced garlic until aromatic and lightly crispy. It's a simple and flavorful dish often seasoned with soy sauce, salt, and pepper. It can be enjoyed on its own or as a versatile side dish.

products.name: Sticky Rice
products.description: 1:1 - Sticky rice, also known as glutinous rice, is a type of rice with a high starch content that gives it a sticky and chewy texture when cooked. It is commonly used in various Asian cuisines.

products.name: Mixed Fried Rice
products.description: Mixed fried rice is a dish that combines cooked rice with a variety of ingredients such as chicken, egg, prawns, and vegetables. These components are stir-fried together, creating a flavorful and well-balanced dish. The rice is often seasoned with soy sauce and other seasonings to enhance the overall taste.

products.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
products.description: Kimchi fried rice is a delicious dish that combines the bold flavors of kimchi and the savory goodness of vegetables and egg . The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with kimchi, a fermented cabbage dish with spicy and tangy flavors.

products.name: Tuna Tartar Salad
products.description: Tuna tartare salad is a dish that involves finely diced or minced raw tuna, typically seasoned with ingredients like soy sauce, sesame oil, lime or lemon juice, and spices. This flavorful tuna tartare is often served on a bed of fresh greens, creating a delicious and refreshing salad.

products.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
products.description: 6 pcs - Tuna nigiri is a type of sushi composed of a small, hand-pressed mound of vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh, raw tuna. This classic sushi offering highlights the natural flavors of the tuna and the seasoned rice, often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish.

products.name: Tuna Sashimi
products.description: 5 slice - Tuna sashimi is a Japanese dish that features thinly sliced, fresh raw tuna served as a delicacy. The tuna is typically high-quality and is presented in an aesthetically pleasing manner.

products.name: Tuna Maki
products.description: 6 pcs - Tuna maki is a type of sushi roll that consists of vinegared rice, seaweed (nori), and fresh tuna as the main filling. The ingredients are rolled together using a bamboo mat, and the roll is often accompanied by other components such as cucumber or avocado. Once rolled, it is sliced into bite-sized pieces.

products.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
products.description: 6pcs - Spicy Tuna Roll: A sushi classic with a spicy twist. Inside, enjoy a tantalizing blend of fresh tuna mixed with a fiery spicy mayo sauce, delivering a perfect harmony of heat and savory goodness. Encased in seaweed and rice, this roll offers a delightful kick for those who appreciate a bit of spice in their sushi.

products.name: Torched Crab Roll
products.description: 6 pcs - The Torched Roll is a flavorful sushi creation filled with crab stick and avocado, cucumber wrapped in sushi rice. Topped with a layer of crab meat mixed with mayonnaise, the roll is then carefully torched, creating a savory and visually appealing dish. The torching adds a smoky touch to the crab and enhances the overall taste of the roll

products.name: Rainbow California Roll
products.description: 6pcs - Rainbow California Roll: Experience a burst of colors and flavors with our Rainbow California Roll. This classic roll is crafted with a center of crab or imitation crab, cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in seaweed and rice. What sets it apart is the vibrant array of fresh sashimi-style fish, including tuna, salmon, and avocado, artfully arranged on top.

products.name: California Roll
products.description: 6 pcs- California Roll: A classic sushi roll that has stood the test of time, the California Roll features a filling of imitation crab or real crab, cucumber, and avocado, rolled in seaweed and rice. The roll is often served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce for dipping.

products.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
products.description: 6pcs - Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll: Ignite your taste buds with our Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll. Inside, revel in the harmony of creamy avocado, succulent crab stick, and crisp carrot, all enhanced with our signature sauce. Topped with a layer of torched crab stick and cucumber, this roll delivers a fiery sensation that will leave you enchanted.

products.name: Hot Night Roll
products.description: 6 pcs - Hot Night Roll: Dive into the vibrant flavors of our Summer Roll, a delightful combination of fried prawn, creamy cheese, avocado, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with luscious tuna and torched to perfection, it's crowned with a tantalizing spicy mayonnaise sauce.

products.name: Tiger Roll
products.description: 6pcs - Tiger Roll: Unleash the bold flavors of our Tiger Roll, featuring a delectable combination of creamy cheese, ripe avocado, crispy fried prawn, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with a luscious drizzle of honey mustard sauce and a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), this roll embodies the perfect balance of textures and tastes.

products.name: Spicy California Roll
products.description: 6 pcs - A Spicy California Roll is essentially a California Roll with added Sriracha or spicy sauce, providing a kick of heat to the classic combination of crab, avocado, and cucumber. Adjust the spice level to your preference and enjoy!

products.name: Volcano Roll
products.description: 6pcs - Volcano Roll: Indulge in the explosive flavors of our Volcano Roll, featuring succulent fried prawn, creamy avocado, and luscious cheese. Torched to perfection and generously drizzled with spicy mayonnaise sauce, this roll delivers a fiery kick. Topped with a crunchy eruption, our Volcano Roll is a symphony of textures and tastes that will ignite your taste buds.

products.name: Mixed Fried Noodles
products.description: Mixed Fried Noodles consist of egg noodles stir-fried with tender chicken pieces, an assortment of colorful vegetables, and a blend of spices. The dish offers a delightful medley of textures and flavors, making it a satisfying and well-rounded meal.

products.name: Japche - Glass Noodles
products.description: Japchae is a Korean dish featuring sweet potato glass noodles stir-fried with a mix of colorful vegetables, Chicken and seasoned with a soy-sesame oil sauce. It's known for its chewy texture and delicious blend of flavors.

products.name: Mandu Ramen
products.description: Mandu Ramen is a dish featuring ramen noodles, 2 pieces of chicken mandu (dumplings), and additional ingredients like vegetables in a flavorful broth. It's a hearty and satisfying combination of ramen and dumplings.

products.name: Dak Gae Jung
products.description: 1:1 - Dak Gae Jang: A bold and hearty Korean dish, Dak Gae Jang is a spicy chicken stew that delights the palate with robust flavors. Tender pieces of chicken are simmered in a rich, spicy broth infused with garlic, ginger, and Korean chili paste. The stew is further enriched with soy sauce and sesame oil, creating a complex and savory profile.

products.name: Thick Thai Soup
products.description: Thai-inspired soup is full of chunks of tender meat, lemongrass & prawns

products.name: Champong Soup
products.description: 1:1 - Kimchi Jjigae : Experience the heartiness of Korean comfort food with our Kimchi Jjigae . This stew boasts the bold flavors of kimchi, tofu, and an array of vegetables simmered in a flavorful broth. The combination of spicy, savory, and tangy notes creates a soul-warming dish that embodies the essence of Korean cuisine.

products.name: Kimchi Jjigae
products.description: Served with chicken

products.name: Spicy Seafood Soup
products.description: Savor the heat with our Spicy Seafood Soup. Loaded with a medley of fresh seafood such as shrimp, clams and squid, this soup boasts a fiery broth infused with spicy elements, garlic, ginger, and flavorful spices. A satisfying and bold choice for those craving a spicy and flavorful seafood experience.
